settings.heading: Lada
settings.lede: Spun, woven and finished under our own roof. The only cloth in this shop whose every thread we answer for.

settings.title: The yarn
settings.text: We buy staple long enough to hold a twist, and spin to a count we set ourselves. It is the one decision that fixes everything downstream.

settings.title: The loom
settings.text: Woven slowly, at a tension that leaves the cloth room to move. A fast bolt looks the same on the shelf and fails in the third season.

settings.title: The hand
settings.text: Washed, pressed and shrunk before it is ever cut, so what you measure in the shop is what you keep after the first wash.

settings.heading: Three hands, one bolt
settings.intro: Most of the shelf is chosen. This is the part we make. Every stage happens at our own unit in Sheikhupura, which is why the guarantee on it is unconditional.
